author: cogs-cogs
install_msg: RemindConfirm installed! Use `[p]rc` to manage recurring confirmation reminders.
name: RemindConfirm
short: Recurring reminders that require reaction confirmations from specified users.
description: Schedule reminders on an interval or weekly basis. Each fire starts a nag loop that re-sends the message until all specified users confirm via reaction emoji, or the nag window expires. Confirmation state carries over within each occurrence.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs for reminder targets and confirmation tracking.
